test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank:
The National Digital Health Mission's (NDHM) primary aim is to create a unique ________ for every Indian citizen.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Health ID**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **National Digital Health Mission (NDHM)**, now known as the **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)**, was launched by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** on **August 15, 2020**.

• The primary aim of the mission is to provide a **Health ID** (now referred to as **ABHA - Ayushman Bharat Health Account**) to every Indian citizen to digitize their health records.

• The **Health ID** serves as a repository for all health-related information, including **medical history**, **prescriptions**, **diagnostic reports**, and **discharge summaries**, ensuring seamless access to healthcare services across the country.

• **Vaccine ID** is a specific identifier for immunization status and is not the overarching goal of the NDHM.

• **Aadhaar ID** is a 12-digit unique identity number for residents of India for general identification, while the Health ID is specifically designed for the **healthcare ecosystem**.

• A **Disease Registry** is a database that collects information about individuals diagnosed with a specific condition, which is a component of the health system but not the primary identification tool for every citizen.

**Additional Information__**

• The **National Health Authority (NHA)** is the implementing agency for the **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission**.

• The **ABHA number** is a **14-digit** unique identification number that can be generated using an **Aadhaar card** or a **mobile number**.

• The mission also includes the **Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR)** and **Health Facility Registry (HFR)** to bring all stakeholders (doctors, hospitals, and labs) onto a single digital platform.

• It promotes **interoperability** within the digital health ecosystem, allowing patients to share their health profiles with doctors and insurance providers digitally with their **informed consent**.
